question: Which product category generated the highest total revenue (price times quantity) from completed orders? Return the category and its total revenue (rounded to 2 decimal places), as columns category and total_revenue.

gold.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, ROUND(SUM(p.price * oi.quantity), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
